limitations: The native check is one isolated emulator smoke test, not physical Z Fold testing or broad device acceptance. Cold gameplay loading was slow and codec/WebGL warnings occurred. Android onboarding hero decoder behavior, native World Continue, physical audio and offline resume were not verified in this check.
Scoped test results do not establish a clean full Flutter suite or replace earlier release limitations; preserved build manifests retain their original evidence.

Third-party AdMob monetization remains disabled, but the feed contains house promotions. This website APK is not a claim of Google Play or App Store approval, physical-device acceptance or a completed real-account deletion.
